title: Fast Documents, Expensive Corrections
description: A service copies a user's current delivery address into three document views so each screen loads by key. The product requires corrections to reach every current-address view. What must the design add?

options.text: An assumption that flexible schemas update copied values automatically.
options.explanation: Schema flexibility changes validation responsibility, not synchronization between copies.

options.text: More document replicas with the same three stale copies.
options.explanation: Replication copies each document's state; it does not derive updates across separate documents.

options.text: An explicit propagation and reconciliation policy for the copies.
options.explanation: Denormalization moves work from reads to writes and recovery. State the authoritative address, how changes propagate and what readers see while copies lag.

options.text: A rule that NoSQL is always faster, so correction cost can be ignored.
options.explanation: Performance depends on the access pattern, and correctness requirements still apply regardless of the database family.
